name: pageshotter
description: Full-page, visible-area and selection screenshots for Chrome, captured and edited locally.

scripts.package:edge: node scripts/build.mjs --target edge && node scripts/package.mjs --target edge
scripts.package:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs --target firefox && node scripts/package.mjs --target firefox --source
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:pages && npm run build && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox
